title: CivCraftRP
description: The plugin ecosystem that turns your Minecraft server into a living society, with crime, justice, reputation and memory
body:
# ⚖️ CivCraft ### *The heart of the CivCraft Suite* ![CivCraft Suite Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0c64d2386a42173f5672eed6530ab9d8abfe3413_0.webp) ![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-1.0.0-gold) ![Minecraft](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.21.x-green) ![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-Paper%20%7C%20Spigot%20%7C%20Purpur-blue) ![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-lightgrey) **One plugin to rule them all.** *CivCraft is the central manager of the CivCraft Suite*
--- ## 🌍 What is the CivCraft Suite? In most Minecraft servers, society doesn't really exist. A player can kill, grief, steal and walk away five minutes later like nothing happened. No memory. No social consequences. No justice. **CivCraft Suite changes that from the ground up.** | Plugin | Role | |--------|------| | ⚔️ **ReanimateMC** | You don't die instantly. You go down. Allies can save you. | | 🏹 **BountyBoard** | Anyone can put a price on your head — on a physical sign in the world. | | 🕵️ **Witness** | Crimes committed in front of witnesses are recorded as official evidence. | | 🪪 **Reputation** | Your actions shape your identity. Your score floats above your head. | | ⚖️ **Tribunal** | Player-elected judges run real trials, with juries and real consequences. | | 🪦 **Epitaph** | Every death is carved in stone. The world remembers. | --- ## 🔧 What does CivCraft do? > CivCraft is not a gameplay plugin. **It's the glue.** - 🔗 **Connects** all suite plugins through a shared API with no hard dependencies between them - 🎛️ **Unified config** Manage the entire suite from a single `/civcraft` command - 📊 **Live dashboard** Monitor active events, plugin statuses and server-wide statistics - 🔄 **Auto-detection** Automatically activates integrations when suite plugins are found - 🗄️ **Shared data layer** Handles cross-plugin communication so each plugin stays lightweight -- ## 💻 Commands Available as `/civcraft`, `/civ` and `/cc`. | Command | Permission | Description | |---------|------------|-------------| | `/civ status` | `civcraft.use` | Live dashboard of all installed suite modules | | `/civ doctor` | `civcraft.admin` | Diagnose configuration issues and missing integrations | | `/civ reload` | `civcraft.admin` | Reload the entire suite in dependency order | | `/civ reload ` | `civcraft.admin` | Reload a specific plugin of the suite | | `/civ version` | `civcraft.use` | Display versions of all detected suite plugins | --- ## 🔑 Permissions | Permission | Default | Description | |------------|---------|-------------| | `civcraft.use` | ✅ Everyone | View suite status and versions | | `civcraft.admin` | ⚙️ OP | Run diagnostics, reloads and admin commands | --- --- ## 📦 Installation **CivCraft is required** if you run two or more plugins of the suite. If you only use one plugin standalone, CivCraft is optional.
*Crime. Witnesses. Bounties. Reputation. Trials. Graves.*
**This is CivCraft.**
